inputs.legacy_event: Agent events and persisted event dictionaries with type, error/code, and optional metadata.
inputs.canonical_failure: A top-level failure object containing every required v1 field.

failure.location: Runtime dataclass failure attribute and serialized event top-level failure field.

errors: failure envelope is not an object
failure envelope is missing a required v1 field
failure envelope has an unknown kind or origin
failure envelope has an unsupported retry policy
failure envelope has an unknown major schema version

compatibility.unknown_minor_fields: preserve unchanged when parsing and serializing a supported major
compatibility.legacy_events: map deterministically without deleting their documented error, code, or metadata fields
compatibility.persistence: terminal error records persist a top-level versioned failure object
compatibility.denials_and_steering: map to tool_denied and runtime_steering, never tool_error

failure_schema.diagnostics_ref: An opaque reference or null; failure envelopes never carry raw restricted diagnostics.
